posts.title: Introducing TextEach: Text a Group Without the Group Chat
posts.description: I built an iPhone app that sends one message to a group as separate texts. Everyone gets their own text with their name in it, and replies come back to you.

posts.description: I compared six weather APIs for a month to see which forecasts came closest. Here’s what I’d choose for temperature, wind, and everyday weather checks.
